entries.en: The company booked an all-suite hotel for the visiting delegates.
entries.zh: 公司为来访代表预订了一家全套房酒店。

entries.en: An all-suites hotel appeared at the top of her shortlist.
entries.zh: 一家只提供套房的旅馆排在她的候选名单首位。

entries.en: The guide parked the all-terrain vehicle beside the muddy track.
entries.zh: 向导把全地形车停在泥泞小路旁。

entries.en: The organisers made the final an all-ticket event to control attendance.
entries.zh: 组织者将决赛设为需要预先购票的活动，以控制到场人数。

entries.en: The chapter examines recruitment within an all-volunteer military system.
entries.zh: 这一章考察了纯志愿兵役制中的招募工作。

entries.en: He restored the all-wave receiver before connecting it to the antenna.
entries.zh: 他修复了那台全波段接收机，然后将其接到天线上。

entries.en: The tailor chose a fabric with all-way stretch for the dance costume.
entries.zh: 裁缝为那套舞蹈服选了一种可向各个方向伸展的面料。

entries.en: The inspector checked the joints in the all-welded frame.
entries.zh: 检查员检查了全焊框架中的接头。

entries.en: The lodge advertised all-year accommodation rather than a short summer season.
entries.zh: 那家旅舍宣传全年提供住宿，而不是仅在短暂的夏季营业。

entries.en: Her allegoristic tale gave each animal a different political ambition.
entries.zh: 她那篇用寓言作比喻的故事赋予了每只动物不同的政治抱负。

entries.en: The researchers stored the isolated allelochemic in a labelled vial.
entries.zh: 研究人员把分离出的种间化学物质存放在有标签的小瓶中。

entries.en: The laboratory detected an allelochemical in samples from the growing trays.
entries.zh: 实验室在育苗盘的样本中检测出了一种化感素。

entries.en: The botanist investigated an allelopathic interaction between the two plants.
entries.zh: 植物学家调查了这两株植物之间的植化相克作用。

entries.en: The negotiator considered the two factions alliable despite their old disputes.
entries.zh: 尽管两派之间有旧怨，谈判者仍认为它们可以结盟。

entries.en: The geologist placed the allitic soil sample in a separate tray.
entries.zh: 地质学家把富铝土样单独放在一只托盘里。

entries.en: The artist tested an allochroic pigment on a spare ceramic tile.
entries.zh: 艺术家在一块备用瓷砖上试用了一种变色颜料。

entries.meaningZh: 完全保有地产所有权的〔地产制度〕
entries.en: The archivist found a deed describing the estate as allodial.
entries.zh: 档案员发现了一份将那处地产描述为完全保有所有权的契据。

entries.en: The protocol listed the allogenic grafts separately from the other specimens.
entries.zh: 方案将同种异体移植物与其他标本分开列出。

entries.en: The researchers selected an allohaploid for further chromosome analysis.
entries.zh: 研究人员选取了一个异源单倍体进行进一步的染色体分析。

entries.en: The paper compares alloimmune responses under two experimental conditions.
entries.zh: 论文比较了两种实验条件下的同种免疫反应。

entries.meaningZh: 非印欧语系且非闪语族的〔旧分类用语〕
entries.en: The old reference work used an Allophylian category in its language tables.
entries.zh: 那部旧参考书在语言表中使用了一个非印欧语系且非闪语族的类别。

entries.en: The researcher circled the allosteric site on the enzyme model.
entries.zh: 研究人员在酶模型上圈出了变构位点。

entries.en: The greenhouse team kept the allotetraploid separate from the parent plants.
entries.zh: 温室团队把那个异源四倍体与亲本植物分开放置。

entries.en: The allotriploid was selected for a separate growth trial.
entries.zh: 那个异源三倍体被选入了一项单独的生长试验。

entries.en: The experiment compared allotrophic growth under two nutrient conditions.
entries.zh: 实验比较了两种营养条件下的异养生长。

entries.en: The survey mapped an alluvious deposit beneath the abandoned orchard.
entries.zh: 调查绘出了废弃果园下方冲积物的分布。

entries.en: The theorem establishes almost-certain convergence without fixing the limiting value.
entries.zh: 这个定理确立了几乎必然收敛，但没有确定极限值。

entries.en: An aloetic preparation appeared in the old dispensary's inventory.
entries.zh: 一种含芦荟的制剂出现在旧药房的清单中。

entries.en: The critic admired the dream's alogical sequence of images.
entries.zh: 评论家欣赏那场梦中不遵循逻辑的意象排列。

entries.en: The lecturer highlighted the alpha-adrenergic receptor in the signalling diagram.
entries.zh: 讲师在信号传导图中突出标示了α肾上腺素能受体。

entries.en: The student coloured the alpha-helical segment blue on the protein model.
entries.zh: 学生在蛋白质模型上把α螺旋结构的片段涂成了蓝色。

entries.en: The form accepts an alphabetic-numeric code in the final field.
entries.zh: 表单的最后一个字段接受字母数字编码。

entries.meaningZh: 几何法字图显示的〔计算机〕
entries.en: The emulator restored the terminal's alphageometric display mode.
entries.zh: 模拟器恢复了终端的几何法字图显示模式。

entries.en: Her sketch labels the alphahelical region beside the folded sheet.
entries.zh: 她的草图在折叠片层旁标注了α螺旋结构区域。

entries.meaningZh: 镶嵌法字图显示的〔计算机〕
entries.en: The demonstration used an alphamosaic screen to show letters and block graphics.
entries.zh: 演示使用镶嵌法字图显示屏呈现字母和块状图形。

entries.en: The border has altern bands of red and gold.
entries.zh: 边框上有红色和金色交错的条带。

entries.en: The performance used alternant voices to recount the same event.
entries.zh: 演出采用交替的人声讲述同一件事。

entries.en: His altisonant promises impressed the audience but left the schedule unchanged.
entries.zh: 他冠冕堂皇的承诺打动了听众，却没有改变日程安排。

entries.en: The chemist compared aluminic compounds with the iron compounds on the tray.
entries.zh: 化学研究人员将铝化合物与托盘上的铁化合物作了比较。

entries.en: The crew prepared the aluminothermic welding equipment before the rail repair.
entries.zh: 施工队在维修铁轨之前准备好了铝热焊设备。

entries.en: The alumnal newsletter carried photographs from the reunion in June.
entries.zh: 校友通讯刊登了六月聚会的照片。

entries.en: The artist mixed an alutaceous shade for the animal's belly.
entries.zh: 画家为动物腹部调出了一种牛皮色。

entries.en: An always-on display glowed beside the dark computer monitor.
entries.zh: 一块始终开启的显示屏在黑着的电脑显示器旁发着光。

entries.en: The technician labelled the amalgamable sample before the next test.
entries.zh: 技术员在下一次测试前给可合汞的样本贴上了标签。

entries.en: The waiter brought trout amandine with a small dish of potatoes.
entries.zh: 侍者端来了配杏仁的鳟鱼，旁边还有一小碟土豆。

entries.en: The gardener separated the amaryllidaceous bulbs from the other planting stock.
entries.zh: 园丁把石蒜科植物的鳞茎与其他种植材料分开。

entries.en: Her amatorial verses were tucked between the pages of a travel journal.
entries.zh: 她的情诗夹在一本旅行日记的书页之间。

entries.en: The comedy turns on an amatorious letter delivered to the wrong person.
entries.zh: 这部喜剧围绕一封送错对象的情书展开。

entries.en: An amber-like glow spread across the painted ceiling at sunset.
entries.zh: 日落时分，一片琥珀色的光晕铺展在彩绘天花板上。

entries.en: The ambidexter switched the pen to her other hand without pausing.
entries.zh: 那个两手俱利的人没有停顿，就把笔换到了另一只手。

entries.en: The ambilingual guide switched languages when the second group arrived.
entries.zh: 精通两种语言的导游在第二批游客到达时切换了语言。

entries.en: The sketch shows an ambiparous shoot beside a bare stem.
entries.zh: 草图上，一段花叶兼具的枝条画在一根光秃的茎旁。

entries.en: The physicist compared ambipolar transport in the two simulated layers.
entries.zh: 物理学家比较了两个模拟层中的双极性输运。

entries.en: The ambisinister apprentice dropped the tongs after switching hands.
entries.zh: 那个两手均不灵活的学徒换手后弄掉了钳子。

entries.en: I was ambisinistrous with the chopsticks and asked for a fork.
entries.zh: 我用筷子时两手都不灵活，便要了一把叉子。

entries.meaningZh: 兼属前后两音节的〔辅音〕
entries.en: The lecturer marked the ambisyllabic consonant between the two vowel symbols.
entries.zh: 讲师标出了两个元音符号之间兼属前后两音节的辅音。

entries.en: The technician compared the amblychromatic nuclei on two slides.
entries.zh: 技术员比较了两张切片中弱染的细胞核。

entries.en: The audit identified an ameliorable weakness in the training programme.
entries.zh: 审查发现培训计划中有一个可以改善的薄弱环节。

entries.en: The old code listed the breach as amerceable rather than punishable by imprisonment.
entries.zh: 旧法典将这种违规列为可罚款的行为，而不是可处监禁的行为。

entries.en: The novel follows an American-led expedition through an imaginary mountain range.
entries.zh: 小说讲述了一支以美国为首的探险队穿越虚构山脉的经历。

entries.meaningZh: 石棉样的〔软骨退变纤维〕
entries.en: The pathologist traced the amianthoid fibres in the cartilage image.
entries.zh: 病理学家在软骨图像中描出了石棉样纤维。

entries.en: The technician kept the amicrobic sample sealed until the demonstration.
entries.zh: 技术员让无菌样本保持密封，直到演示开始。

entries.en: The researchers counted amicronucleate cells in two culture samples.
entries.zh: 研究人员统计了两份培养样本中缺乏微核的细胞数量。

entries.en: The chemist separated an amidable fraction from the original mixture.
entries.zh: 化学研究人员从原混合物中分离出了可酰氨化的部分。

entries.en: The team compared two amidating reagents before selecting the experimental conditions.
entries.zh: 团队比较了两种酰氨化试剂，然后选择实验条件。

entries.en: The report lists three aminable compounds selected for further testing.
entries.zh: 报告列出了选作进一步测试的三种可氨化化合物。

entries.en: The chemist circled the aminomethyl group on the structural drawing.
entries.zh: 化学研究人员在结构图上圈出了氨甲基。

entries.en: The survey recorded ammocolous organisms beneath the loose surface sand.
entries.zh: 调查记录了松散表层沙下方的栖砂生物。

entries.en: The poem's amoebean structure lets the two speakers answer each other.
entries.zh: 这首诗的对答体结构让两个发言者相互回应。

entries.en: The artist pressed the amorphic mass of clay into a shallow tray.
entries.zh: 艺术家把那团无定形的黏土压进一个浅盘。

entries.en: The accountant compared two hypothetical amortizable loans in the worksheet.
entries.zh: 会计在工作表中比较了两笔假设的可分批偿还贷款。

entries.en: The counsellor discussed the student's amotivational state during the session.
entries.zh: 辅导员在咨询过程中讨论了那个学生缺乏动机的状态。

entries.en: The band was amped when the crowd began singing the opening line.
entries.zh: 观众开始唱开场的那句歌词时，乐队兴奋不已。

entries.en: The technician checked the amperometric instrument before recording another reading.
entries.zh: 技术员检查了电流测量仪器，然后记录了另一个读数。

entries.en: The botanist labelled the two fruit types on the amphicarpous specimen.
entries.zh: 植物学家在那份具两种果实的标本上标注了两类果实。

entries.en: The chapter compares amphictyonic councils with the assemblies of individual cities.
entries.zh: 这一章将近邻同盟的议事会与各城的集会作了比较。

entries.en: The study compared amphigenetic reproduction with an asexual process in the model.
entries.zh: 研究比较了模型中的有性生殖与一种无性过程。

entries.en: The researcher photographed the leaf's amphigenous fungal growth before drying it.
entries.zh: 研究人员在干燥叶片之前，拍下了叶片两面的真菌生长物。

entries.en: The researchers modelled an amphimictic population under two inheritance assumptions.
entries.zh: 研究人员在两种遗传假设下对两性融合繁殖的种群进行了建模。

entries.en: The anatomist rotated the amphiplatyan vertebra model beneath the lamp.
entries.zh: 解剖学家在灯下转动那个两端平的椎骨模型。

entries.en: The botanist examined the amphistomous leaf through a microscope.
entries.zh: 植物学家通过显微镜检查了那片两面有气孔的叶子。

entries.en: The architect arranged amphitheatral seating around the central performance space.
entries.zh: 建筑师在中央表演区周围布置了圆剧场式的座席。

entries.en: The drawing shows an amplectant stem winding around the wooden support.
entries.zh: 图上画着一根盘绕木支架攀附生长的茎。

entries.en: The seminar contrasted ampliative reasoning with arguments that merely restated their premises.
entries.zh: 研讨课将扩展性推理与只是重述前提的论证作了对比。

entries.en: The critic admired the speech's amplificative passages more than its abrupt conclusion.
entries.zh: 相较于突兀的结尾，评论家更欣赏讲话中铺陈的段落。

entries.en: The technician replaced an amplificatory component in the old receiver.
entries.zh: 技术员更换了旧接收机中的一个放大元件。

entries.en: The illustrator drew an ampullaceal chamber at the end of the tube.
entries.zh: 插画师在管子末端画了一个坛形腔室。

entries.en: The potter placed the ampullaceous vessel beside the shallow bowls.
entries.zh: 陶工把那个瓶状器皿放在浅碗旁边。

entries.en: The glassblower shaped an ampulliform bulb at one end of the tube.
entries.zh: 玻璃吹制工在管子一端做出了一个安瓿形的膨大部。

entries.meaningZh: 蔷薇科李属植物的〔旧分类用语〕
entries.en: The catalogue groups the amygdalaceous plants in a separate section.
entries.zh: 目录将蔷薇科李属植物归在单独的一节中。

entries.en: The jeweller chose an amygdalate stone for the silver ring.
entries.zh: 珠宝匠为那枚银戒指选了一块巴旦杏状的宝石。

entries.en: The laboratory logged amyloclastic activity before storing the remaining sample.
entries.zh: 实验室记录了分解淀粉的活性，然后储存剩余样本。

entries.en: The botanist moved the anacardiaceous seedling into a larger pot.
entries.zh: 植物学家把那棵漆树科幼苗移进了一个更大的花盆。

entries.meaningZh: 谨小慎微的〔非正式，常含贬义〕
entries.en: The narrator mocks his anal-retentive habit of labelling every spare button.
entries.zh: 叙述者嘲笑他谨小慎微，连每颗备用纽扣都要贴上标签。

entries.en: The publisher added three essays to the analectic volume.
entries.zh: 出版社向那部文选中增收了三篇文章。

entries.en: An analog-to-digital converter linked the sensor to the recording system.
entries.zh: 一个模拟数字转换器将传感器接到了记录系统。

entries.en: The essay uses analogial reasoning to connect the two imagined societies.
entries.zh: 这篇文章用类推推理将两个想象中的社会联系起来。

entries.en: His analogic argument depended on similarities that the other speaker rejected.
entries.zh: 他的比拟论证依赖于一些相似之处，而另一位发言者并不认可这些相似之处。

entries.en: The student separated the anandrous flower from the specimens bearing stamens.
entries.zh: 学生把那朵无雄蕊的花与有雄蕊的标本分开放置。
